title: Foundation Models at Work: Fine-Tuning for Fairness in Algorithmic Hiring

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the 1-Wasserstein distance between target and realized candidate gender distributions, and calculating the True Positive Rate Gap (TPR-GAP) and Impact Ratio (IR) between male and female candidates matched to rewritten job descriptions by a recommendation engine.

Measuring the 1-Wasserstein distance between target and realized geographic distributions of matched candidates, and calculating the Impact Ratio (IR) for candidates across different continents and regions.
